scripts.build:apps: npm run build --prefix apps/assemblies && npm run build --prefix apps/state-logic
scripts.build: npm run build:apps && npm run electron:build --prefix apps/shell
scripts.install:all: npm install --workspaces && npm install --prefix apps/calendar/server && npm install --prefix apps/shell
scripts.deploy: npm run build:apps && pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:configs && npm run lint --prefix apps/assemblies && npm run lint --prefix apps/build-readiness && npm run lint --prefix apps/calendar && npm run lint --prefix apps/shell && npm run lint --prefix apps/state-logic && npm run lint --prefix apps/reports
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/assemblies && npm test --prefix apps/build-readiness && npm test --prefix apps/calendar && npm test --prefix apps/shell && npm test --prefix apps/state-logic && npm test --prefix apps/reports
